metadata.scenario: A potential client calls to ask about the qualifications of the physical therapists available at the clinic. Category: New Inquiry. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Betty Lou Smith. I'm calling to ask about the physical therapists you have available. Hi Betty, it’s great to hear from you! I can definitely provide you with that information. Thank you. I'm interested in their qualifications and specialties. Our physical therapist, Dr. James Rodriguez, specializes in post-surgery rehabilitation, fall prevention, and mobility training. That sounds good. What kind of qualifications does he have? Dr. Rodriguez is a licensed physical therapist with over 10 years of experience in home health care. Wow, that’s impressive! Does he have experience with clients who have had multiple falls? Yes, he has extensive experience in fall prevention and has worked with many clients in similar situations. That’s reassuring. How does the scheduling work for sessions with him? Dr. Rodriguez is available Monday through Friday, and sessions can be scheduled based on your needs. Great! How long is each session, and what’s the cost? Each session typically lasts 45 to 60 minutes, and the cost ranges from $110 to $140 per visit. Okay, that sounds reasonable. Do you accept insurance? Yes, we do accept various insurances, and I can help you with the authorization process. That would be helpful. Can you tell me how I can get started with this? Sure! I can connect you with our care coordinator, Lisa Chen, to handle the intake process. Perfect! What’s her extension? Lisa’s extension is 203. She’s available Monday through Saturday. Thank you, Margaret. I’ll reach out to her. You’re welcome! Would you like me to note down your interest for follow-up? Yes, please. I’d appreciate a follow-up call after I speak with Lisa. Absolutely! I’ll make a note to follow up with you in a couple of days. Thank you so much. I feel much more informed now! It’s my pleasure, Betty. If you have any other questions, don’t hesitate to call. I will! Have a great day. You too! Bye now.
